Our Mission

The end of reactive cloud security.

Senior Account Executive
GTM / Sales · help take our vision global
Location: US Full-Time Go-to-Market

About Us

Blast Security marks the end of reactive cloud security, replacing after-the-fact response with continuous prevention. Instead of reacting to threats and chasing alerts, Blast creates a living, preemptive defense fabric that continuously evolves with the enterprise cloud environment, eliminating alert fatigue, reducing operational friction, and shrinking the blast radius. For CISOs and security leaders, Blast delivers preemptive risk reduction and continuous control. Cloud and platform architects gain safe, scalable orchestration of native controls. SecOps and incident response teams see fewer alerts, blocked lateral movement, and less repetitive remediation, allowing them to focus on real threats and maintain environments secure by design.

We’re backed by top-tier global investors and are building a category-defining company. We’re now looking for a Senior Account Executive to join our GTM team and help take our vision global.

About the Role

Blast is hiring a senior sales leader to drive commercial momentum and establish a repeatable enterprise sales motion. This role blends hands-on selling with building the operating foundations that enable consistent execution as the company grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Execution: Own the full enterprise and upper mid-market sales cycle from first engagement through close, leading evaluations and negotiations with strong discipline while navigating complex buying groups and building trusted executive relationships.
  • Go-to-Market Development: Shape target segments, buyer profiles, and positioning by translating real market feedback into clear, outcome-driven messaging and a repeatable discovery-to-deal motion.
  • Sales Process and Operating Rhythm: Establish a pragmatic sales operating system with strong CRM hygiene, clear stages, forecasting discipline, and lightweight standards for qualification, deal strategy, and executive alignment.
  • Sales Enablement and Core Assets: Build and continuously refine core sales assets, talk tracks, and pitch structures, tailoring messaging to CISOs, cloud security, and platform leaders based on customer insight and product learning.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner tightly with product and marketing to align messaging and packaging, feeding commercial insights back into the organization to accelerate closes and expansion.
  • Ecosystem and Presence: Develop strategic relationships across the cloud and security ecosystem and represent the company confidently in executive-level conversations and key industry forums.

What We’re Looking For

Core Sales Experience
  • 6 + years in B2B SaaS enterprise software sales, with meaningful experience in cybersecurity and or cloud.
  • Demonstrated success in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and executive-level negotiation.
  • Strong pipeline management skills and comfort operating with high autonomy.
  • Deep understanding of technical audiences, including CISOs, DevSecOps, Cloud Security Architects, and Platform Engineers.
Builder Mindset
  • Experience operating in early-stage or high-growth environments where structure is created as you go.
  • Ability to move fast without overbuilding, focused on repeatability, clarity, and outcomes.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, iteration, and learning directly from the market.
Cloud and Security Fluency
  • Strong understanding of cloud security buyer dynamics and enterprise constraints.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business and risk outcomes that resonate with leadership.
Collaboration and Ownership
  • Excellent communication and judgment.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts and a customer-first approach.
  • High ownership, high standards, and consistent follow-through.
  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and tactical levels.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with cloud marketplaces and or partner-led enterprise motions.
  • Familiarity with structured qualification frameworks such as MEDDIC or BANT.
  • Network in cloud security communities such as events, roundtables, and practitioner groups.

Location – US

Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer
Blast Security × Professional Services & Core Infrastructure
Experience: 3+ Years Hybrid / Customer-Facing (Central District, Israel) Full-Time R&D / Professional Services

About Blast Security

Blast Security marks the end of reactive cloud security, replacing after-the-fact response with continuous prevention. Instead of reacting to threats and chasing alerts, Blast creates a living, preemptive defense fabric that continuously evolves with the enterprise cloud environment, eliminating alert fatigue, reducing operational friction, and shrinking the blast radius.

We are expanding our core technical team and looking for a senior, hands-on DevOps / Platform Engineer with a strong client-facing orientation. This unique role bridges robust core infrastructure engineering with high-impact Professional Services (PS), working directly with engineering leadership and strategic enterprise accounts.

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned Senior DevOps Engineer who goes beyond internal task execution. In this role, you will split your focus between core infrastructure development and direct, customer-facing Professional Services engagements across multi-cloud environments, modern container platforms, and advanced AI-driven architectures.

As a technical authority, you’ll lead high-impact customer engagements – deploying and customizing DevOps and cloud security solutions directly within client environments – while owning the design, management, and scaling of our multi-account, multi-production cloud organization across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including services such as Transit Gateway, API Gateway, CloudFront, EKS, Lambda, MSK, and Bedrock.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles within SaaS production environments.
  • Cloud: Strong hands-on production experience with AWS, including services such as Transit Gateway, API Gateway, CloudFront, EKS, Lambda, MSK, and Bedrock; experience with GCP and/or Azure is a plus.
  • GitOps: Experience with GitOps platforms, specifically ArgoCD.
  • Kubernetes: Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production environments (mandatory).
  • CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; Argo Workflows is an advantage.
  • Programming: Programming experience in Python, Go, or similar languages.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on expertise with Terraform / OpenTofu (preferred).
  • Linux: Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and tracing tools, such as Grafana.
  • Software Development Understanding: Strong understanding of software development processes and developer workflows.
  • Communication & Leadership: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to independently lead projects and drive initiatives from concept to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Depth: Deep experience with FinOps / cloud cost management – managing spot instances at scale and driving cost governance across a multi-account cloud organization.
  • Multi-Cloud Breadth: Production experience spanning more than one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Database Operations: Experience operating MongoDB, ClickHouse, or DynamoDB at scale in production.

Senior Frontend Engineer
Core R&D / Platform Architecture
Experience: 5+ Years Hybrid / Central District, Israel Full-Time R&D

About Blast Security

Blast Security marks the end of reactive cloud security, replacing after-the-fact response with continuous prevention. Instead of reacting to threats and chasing alerts, Blast creates a living, preemptive defense fabric that continuously evolves with the enterprise cloud environment, eliminating alert fatigue, reducing operational friction, and shrinking the blast radius.

We are expanding our core R&D team and looking for a seasoned, hands-on Senior Frontend Engineer with high hunger, motivation, and a true startup DNA. In this role, you will own and drive the web experience of our core platform, crafting intuitive, high-performance interfaces at the intersection of complex cloud security data and sleek user experience.

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Frontend Engineer who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and wants to make a massive impact from day one. You will take end-to-end ownership of key frontend features: from initial UI architecture and design systems to implementation, performance tuning, and deployment. Working closely with product, design, and backend engineering, you’ll shape both the UX and the technical standards of our web applications, ensuring elegant execution without ever compromising on code quality or performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience building modern, scalable web applications (SaaS) using React and TypeScript.
  • Frontend Architecture: Deep expertise in React architecture, patterns, and best practices (e.g., advanced hooks, state management, component composition, and performance optimization).
  • Startup DNA & Motivation: High hunger, drive, and motivation, with a proven ability to move fast, take full ownership, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • API Integration & Design: Experience designing and consuming modern APIs (REST / GraphQL).
  • UI/UX Standards: High standards for pixel-perfect UI, accessibility (a11y), responsiveness, and user experience.
  • Performance & Debugging: Strong debugging and performance optimization skills (profiling, bundle size reduction, rendering optimization, network efficiency).
  • Testing & Quality: Familiarity with testing practices (unit/e2e testing) and modern CI/CD workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Frontend, Product, UX, and Backend teams to accurately translate complex security needs and requirements into intuitive, seamless user experiences.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a product-minded approach: thinking in outcomes and system scalability.

Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)

  • Next.js & Modern Frameworks: Hands-on experience with Next.js or other modern meta-frameworks.
  • Design Systems: Experience building and maintaining design systems or utilizing tools like Storybook.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Proven experience utilizing AI-powered coding assistants and workflows to accelerate development velocity and elevate code quality.
  • Cybersecurity Domain: Background or hands-on experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or data-heavy enterprise platforms.
